- Explored from 4 independent anchors (features 32, 33, 18, 16, 19) via `init`/`restart` and `extend_best`.

- My `last_gain_at_most` and `best_so_far_above` triggers fired appropriately along the way; I adjusted thresholds twice via `change_trigger`, logging my reasoning each time (loosening an overly strict near-zero-gain restart rule, then lowering the stop bar once results had clearly converged across multiple restarts).
